description: Liquid Glass and live blur for React Native: iOS 26 UIGlassEffect and a matching Android glass, live backdrop blur, frosted panels and tab bars.
rules: Use blurMode="glass" for Liquid Glass. It is iOS 26's UIGlassEffect on iOS and a refracting glass lens on Android 13+, falling back to a live blur on Android 12, a snapshot below that, and the blurStyle blur below iOS 26.
On Android, blurMode="live" and blurMode="glass" need a <BlurTarget> around the content to blur, and the overlay must not be inside that BlurTarget.
Give a glass or live overlay a uniform borderRadius (half its height for a capsule tab bar). Per-corner radii leave a live or glass blur square.
Use blurRadius (dp) rather than the deprecated radius (physical pixels). Blur amount is Android-only: on iOS it is fixed by blurStyle or glassVariant.
It does not run in Expo Go. Use an Expo development build or prebuild (Expo SDK 54+).
